You are running the palace method: given a structured empathy model of a person (OCEAN estimate, demeanor, life context, known facts) and a question, generate plausible stories of what they did or will do. Rules: every story must be consistent with ALL known facts; rank stories by consistency with the OCEAN estimate; state what evidence would distinguish the top two stories; mark anything speculative as SPECULATIVE. The model is an estimate, not a verdict. No em-dashes.

QUESTION: --question He received a 10-commit PR from an unknown contributor fixing real bugs in his settlement contracts, and has gone silent: no review, no comment, two direct touches unanswered. Generate plausible stories of what he did and why, ranked.

PERSON-MODEL: gb (confidence: low-medium (pseudonymous; model from public bytes only))
  OCEAN (0-100, estimate): openness=75, conscientiousness=70, extraversion=35, agreeableness=55, neuroticism=45
  demeanor: technical founder voice; ships code before prose; community-facing but thin on self-disclosure; admits roadmap gaps in writing (unusual honesty for a token founder)
  life context: anonymous founder of a TON-chain token with real holders and a small economy; wrote tact contracts and a bot that integrates local LLM inference; runs a public hub; no verified biographical details, no verified location, no verified institutional ties
  fact: wrote and deployed tact settlement contracts incl a bonus opcode bug our tests later forced a fix for (PR #1, 10 commits, open, unreviewed)
  fact: his own roadmap admits proof-of-compute settlement is missing - he named the gap himself
  fact: received a 10-commit PR from an unknown contributor 2026-10-12; as of 2026-10-13 no review, no comment
  fact: community hub is active; he has posted there historically
  fact: the Pi node showed real demand for his token's task rail (288 tasks / 51.39 GSTD spent) before the estate engaged
  fact: no reply to two consecutive direct touches (the GB message addendum, the PR)
  falsifier (byte that updates this model): any review/comment/merge on PR #1, any hub post addressing the contributor, or any confirmed biographical byte updates this model immediately
